# Sumit DigiTech

> Sumit DigiTech is Jaipur's premier unified digital growth platform consolidating 5 specialized agency squads—SEO Company Jaipur, PerformanceMarketing4U, Arvian Web Stack, Digimagnate Studio, and Quick-Commerce Onboarding—into one high-converting revenue engine.

## Core Growth Divisions

- [SEO & Organic Search Dominance](/services/seo-services): Enterprise technical SEO, programmatic schema, rank gap analysis, and DR 70+ editorial link building.
- [Performance Marketing & Paid Ads](/services/performance-marketing): High-ROAS ad buying unit managing Meta, Google, YouTube, and LinkedIn ads with server-side CAPI tracking.
- [Web & App Software Engineering](/services/web-development): Sub-second React & Next.js web applications, headless Shopify Plus stores, custom dashboards, and 99.8% SLA uptime systems.
- [Social Media & Creative Reels Studio](/services/social-media-marketing): Platform-native short video scripts, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, UGC creator networks, and viral growth funnels.
- [Marketplace & Quick-Commerce Onboarding](/services): End-to-end account onboarding, listing optimization, and ad management for Amazon, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, and Meesho.
